description: List the cities of a country that have active listings, busiest first. Returns each city's slug, name, state or province, escort and venue counts and its escortfox.com link. Use the city slug as `city` in search_listings, and the city's region as `country` where it differs from the country code (US states, e.g. "US-CA").

country.description: The country whose cities to list: its `code` from list_countries (e.g. "DE"), or a region code such as "US-CA" for one state only.

name: list_cities

cities.description: Cities with active listings, busiest first.

subdivision.description: State or province, where the site names one.

title: List cities
